entities.name: Distal esophageal adenocarcinoma
observations: In a fit patient with resectable T3N1 disease, preoperative chemoradiotherapy followed by esophagectomy is a standard trimodality approach.
HER2 positivity does not establish a routine indication for concurrent trastuzumab during neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy.

entities.name: Carboplatin
observations: CROSS-type neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy uses carboplatin AUC 2 weekly with paclitaxel.

entities.name: Paclitaxel
observations: CROSS-type neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy uses paclitaxel 50 mg/m² weekly with carboplatin.

entities.name: Trastuzumab
observations: In NRG/RTOG-1010, adding trastuzumab to paclitaxel/carboplatin plus 50.4 Gy did not improve disease-free survival in HER2-positive resectable esophageal adenocarcinoma: median 19.6 versus 14.2 months; HR 0.99; p=0.97.
Routine concurrent use is therefore not supported outside a clinical trial.

entities.name: CROSS regimen standard
observations: For preoperative chemoradiotherapy to 50.4 Gy, weekly carboplatin AUC 2 plus paclitaxel 50 mg/m² is the most practical guideline-supported regimen among the answer choices.
Cisplatin/5-FU is a legitimate alternative, but the other listed additions are not routinely supported.

entities.name: PMID:35038433 RTOG-1010
observations: Phase III trial of trastuzumab added to preoperative paclitaxel/carboplatin chemoradiotherapy in HER2-overexpressing resectable esophageal adenocarcinoma; no disease-free survival benefit was demonstrated.
